title: Fairy Meadows Trek
summary: Five days from Lahore to Fairy Meadows: the jeep track from Raikot, two nights below Nanga Parbat and a walk towards its base camp.

image.alt: First sunlight on the summit of Nanga Parbat above the Raikot glacier and the pines of Fairy Meadows

overview.headline: Two nights at Fairy Meadows, under the north face of Nanga Parbat
paragraphs: The road ends at Raikot Bridge. From there a jeep climbs one of the most dramatic tracks in the country to Tato, and we walk the last three hours up to Fairy Meadows.
We stay two nights in wooden cabins on the meadow. The full day is a walk towards Beyal Camp and the Nanga Parbat base camp viewpoint, with the mountain in front of you all the way.
suitedTo: Fit travellers who enjoy a few hours of uphill walking
Friends and couples looking for a real adventure
Photographers: the morning light on Nanga Parbat is famous
notSuitedTo: Anyone who can’t walk uphill for 3 to 4 hours at altitude
Travellers who are nervous on steep, narrow jeep tracks
Young children and older parents with limited mobility
